description:
Cheapest current rental offers for one GPU family (e.g. "H100", "RTX 5090",
        "b200"), in USD per GPU-hour, cheapest first, one row per provider.
        pricing_type is "on_demand" (default; can't be interrupted) or "spot"
        (cheaper, the provider can reclaim the machine). limit: 1-10.

gpu.description: GPU family name, case-insensitive; aliases work (e.g. "H100", "rtx 5090", "5090", "b200"). Call list_gpu_families for the full list.
gpu.title: Gpu

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, 1-10; values outside the range are clamped.
limit.title: Limit

pricing_type.description: "on_demand" (fixed price, can't be interrupted) or "spot" (cheaper; the provider can reclaim the machine).
pricing_type.title: Pricing Type

name: cheapest_gpu

gpu_name.description: The provider's own name for the GPU or instance.
gpu_name.title: Gpu Name

location.description: Region or data center, when the provider reports one.
location.title: Location

stale.description: True if this provider's last sync failed and this is its last known price (up to 3 days old).
stale.title: Stale

synced_at.description: When this price was last fetched from the provider (ISO 8601, UTC).
synced_at.title: Synced At

gpu_family.description: Canonical GPU family the request resolved to.
gpu_family.title: Gpu Family

median_usd_per_hour.description: Median of each provider's cheapest offer.
median_usd_per_hour.title: Median Usd Per Hour

offers.description: Each provider's cheapest offer, cheapest first.
offers.title: Offers

provider_count.description: Providers with a current offer of this type.
provider_count.title: Provider Count

source_url.description: Matching cheap-gpus.com page for this result.
source_url.title: Source Url

title: Cheapest GPU rentals
